```text
Type: A (Survival Story)
Format: SHORT — IMAGE + VIDEO
Title: Left For Dead on Everest
Target Duration: ~30 seconds
Content: The miraculous survival of Beck Weathers during the 1996 Mount Everest disaster.
Sources:
S01 | Into Thin Air | Jon Krakauer | 1997 | Villard Books | Chapters 17–21
S02 | Left for Dead: My Journey Home from Everest | Beck Weathers | 2000 | Random House | Chapters 1–3
Confirmed Facts: Beck Weathers suffered altitude blindness, was left unconscious in a massive blizzard on the South Col of Everest on May 10–11, 1996. Two search teams assessed him as near death and left him to preserve resources. He lay in a hypothermic coma for approximately 15 hours, woke up due to a vision of his family, stood up, and walked back to Camp IV on his own. He suffered severe frostbite, leading to amputations.
Uncertain / Disputed Details: The exact internal thoughts Beck had while unconscious are reconstructed from his later testimony; they are presented as his own recollected experience.
Episode Bible: Filled under Part 2.
TTS Mode: PLAIN
Visual Approach: FACELESS (Using silhouettes, extreme weather, close-ups of gear, and wide atmospheric environmental shots to avoid generating an inaccurate face).
Video Clip Budget: 2
Channel Handle: @AgainstTheOdds
CTA: NONE
Constraints: Respectful tone, no graphic gore, high accuracy.
```

# PART 2 — 🧭 THE BIBLE

## 👤 CHARACTER / PEOPLE BIBLE

```text
PERSON ID: P01
Verified Name / Role: Beck Weathers / Survivor, American pathologist
Age at Event: 49
Documented Appearance: Dark hair, rugged build, wearing heavy 1996-era high-altitude mountaineering gear.
Documented Clothing / Equipment: Bright yellow and black down-filled expedition suit, thick glacier goggles (removed later), heavy insulated climbing boots, crampons, wool balaclava.
Timeline State: Hypothermic, face covered in ice and frost, hands frozen solid, stiff limbs.
Verified Actions / Attributed Statements: Survived a 15-hour hypothermic coma, regained consciousness, walked back to Camp IV unaided.
Reference Photo: NONE
Depiction Mode: ANONYMOUS_RECONSTRUCTION (Focusing on the yellow down suit, ice-encrusted hood, and silhouette rather than a detailed facial likeness).
Unknowns / Do Not Invent: Do not invent dialogue or show him speaking while unconscious.
Sources: S01, S02
```

## 🗺️ LOCATION BIBLE

```text
LOCATION ID: L01
Verified Name / Region: South Col, Mount Everest (Elevation: ~7,900 meters / 25,900 feet)
Terrain / Water / Cave Features: Flat, wind-swept, gravel-strewn ice plateau surrounded by towering snow peaks.
Date / Season / Time: May 10–11, 1996 / Spring Climbing Season / Night transitioning to late afternoon.
Weather at This Story Beat: Hurricane-force blizzard winds, sub-zero temperatures (minus 30 degrees Celsius), blinding whiteout snow.
Landmarks / Route / Relative Distances: Camp IV tents (small domes of yellow and blue nylon) acting as the only sanctuary on the barren plateau.
Relevant Scale / Orientation: A vast, desolate, frozen expanse where tents are easily lost in a whiteout just dozens of meters away.
Depiction Mode: ILLUSTRATIVE_RECONSTRUCTION
Locked Visual Descriptor: Howling snowstorm over a flat, icy mountain saddle, dark blue-grey shadows, bright yellow and blue dome tents in the distance shaking violently in the wind.
Forbidden Contradictions: No sunny, calm weather during the storm; no green vegetation or low-altitude trees.
Sources: S01
```

# PART 3 — 🧭 SCRIPT PROMPT (Creative Pass)

## 📜 SECTION 1 — SCRIPT

**ESTIMATED RUNTIME:** 32 seconds
**WORD COUNT:** 64 words
**PRIMARY EMOTION:** Courage

```text
🎬 SCENE 1 — THE FROZEN BODY
Duration: 6 seconds
Emotion: Tension

Visual: A wide shot of a lone figure in a yellow down suit lying face-up, partially buried in snow on a frozen mountain plateau during a raging blizzard.
Camera: Slow, low-angle push-in, keeping the figure's face obscured by ice and a hood.

LINE 1:
Text: Left for dead in an Everest blizzard, his body was frozen solid.
Tone: calm
Speed: medium
Pause: 1.0s
On-Screen Text: LEFT FOR DEAD
Source: S01 Chapter 19

🎬 SCENE 2 — THE ABANDONMENT
Duration: 7 seconds
Emotion: Isolation

Visual: Two mountaineers in heavy gear turning their backs to the storm, retreating toward distant, faintly glowing yellow tents in a blinding whiteout.
Camera: High-angle wide shot, static, emphasizing the vast, hostile environment.

LINE 2:
Text: For fifteen hours, Beck Weathers lay in a sub-zero coma. Rescuers abandoned him, certain he was gone.
Tone: restrained
Speed: medium
Pause: 0.8s
On-Screen Text: 15 HOURS IN A COMA
Source: S01 Chapter 20

🎬 SCENE 3 — THE AWAKENING
Duration: 6 seconds
Emotion: Hope

Visual: Macro close-up of an ice-encrusted hood and balaclava. Suddenly, a pair of bloodshot, frost-damaged eyes open wide.
Camera: Static close-up, shallow depth of field.

LINE 3:
Text: But then, his eyes opened.
Tone: tense
Speed: slow
Pause: 1.2s
On-Screen Text: BUT THEN...
Source: S02 Chapter 1

🎬 SCENE 4 — THE STUMBLE
Duration: 7 seconds
Emotion: Courage

Visual: A silhouetted figure in a yellow down suit, limbs stiff like wood, struggling to stand up against howling winds and stumbling forward.
Camera: Mid-shot, tracking slowly beside the figure as he takes painful, uncoordinated steps.

LINE 4:
Text: Blind, and with hands frozen like ice, he stood up. He stumbled toward a tiny blue smudge on the white horizon.
Tone: warm
Speed: medium
Pause: 0.5s
On-Screen Text: WALKING ON ICE
Source: S02 Chapter 2

🎬 SCENE 5 — THE RETURN
Duration: 6 seconds
Emotion: Relief

Visual: The silhouette of Beck Weathers reaching the yellow and blue tents of Camp IV, collapsing into the arms of waiting climbers who emerge from the shelter.
Camera: Low-angle wide shot, looking up at the tents as the rescue occurs.

LINE 5:
Text: Beck Weathers was walking back to life.
Tone: reflective
Speed: slow
Pause: 1.0s
On-Screen Text: BACK TO LIFE
Source: S01 Chapter 21
```

## 🎙️ SECTION 2B — ELEVENLABS COMPLETE VOICED SCRIPT (PASTE-READY)

<script>
Left for dead in an Everest blizzard, his body was frozen solid.

For fifteen hours, Beck Weathers lay in a sub-zero coma. Rescuers abandoned him, certain he was gone.

But then, his eyes opened.

Blind, and with hands frozen like ice, he stood up. He stumbled toward a tiny blue smudge on the white horizon.

Beck Weathers was walking back to life.
</script>

### PUBLISHING PACKAGE

```text
Title Options:
1. Left for Dead on Mount Everest 🏔️
2. The Man Who Woke Up Frozen on Everest
3. He Survived 15 Hours Frozen in a Coma

Description:
In 1996, mountaineer Beck Weathers was left for dead in a blinding blizzard on Mount Everest. After 15 hours in a sub-zero hypothermic coma, his rescuers had given up. This is the extraordinary true story of how he opened his eyes and walked back to life.

Sources:
- "Into Thin Air" by Jon Krakauer (1997)
- "Left for Dead" by Beck Weathers (2000)

Pinned Comment:
What part of Beck's pure determination to see his family again stayed with you the most? 👇

Keywords:
Beck Weathers, Mount Everest 1996, Everest disaster, true survival story, against the odds, survival stories, mountain rescue, frozen alive, survival shorts
```
